title: Retain data before a line feed after a lone carriage return
summary: A lone carriage return now preserves both intervening bytes before the line feed. Splitting a UTF-8 character and adjacent carriage returns across buffers yielded the same two decoded strings.

change.description: The two-byte delimiter matcher resets an incomplete match on a mismatch and considers that same byte as a possible new start. The comparison uses the first parent of the branch merge, taking in the three changed files.

notes: Each subscription received fresh heap buffers and was collected to completion. Both revisions retained ordinary CRLF and LF behavior.
